// GUI Event Graphs for unit U06_Alarms

// Graph 1: Alarm detection and display on main screen (covers RW-SW-66, RW-SW-69, RW-SW-71, RW-SW-73, RW-SW-74)
Start
  |
  v
[GUI Initialized] --(1)--> [Controller Receives Alarm Signal] --(2)--> [Controller Processes Alarm]
  |                                                       |
  |(3) Priority Assigned                                    |(4) Priority Assigned
  |                                                       |
  v                                                       v
[GUI Updates Main Screen] <-(5)--------------------------[GUI Updates Main Screen]
  |                                                       |
  |(6) High Severity Alarm (Red, Flash 2Hz)            |(7) Low Severity Alarm (Yellow, Constant)
  |                                                       |
  v                                                       v
[Alarm Visible at 1m] <-(8)--------------------------[Alarm Visible at 1m]

// Graph 2: Alarm list display on button press (covers RW-SW-70)
Start
  |
  v
[User Presses Alarm List Button] --(9)--> [Controller Retrieves Active Alarms]
  |
  v
[GUI Displays Active Alarms List] --(10)--> [User Can Interact with Main Screen]

// Graph 3: Buzzer command (covers RW-SW-67)
Start
  |
  v
[Controller Sends Buzzer Command] --(11)--> [Hardware PCB Buzzer Activated]
